{"code":"import random

def generate(rng):
    h=rng.randint(3,10)
    w=rng.randint(3,10)
    bg=0
    grid=[[bg for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    # Sparse, varied colored objects on a zero background, as typical ARC inputs.
    n=rng.randint(1,max(1,(h*w)//4))
    for _ in range(n):
        i=rng.randrange(h); j=rng.randrange(w)
        grid[i][j]=rng.randint(1,9)
    return grid"}
